cases.text: We have not approved the contract. We have not promised to sign it this week, and we have not agreed to automatic renewal or paid the deposit.
cases.context: The supplier is asking whether an equipment purchase agreement can proceed. In this agreement, the deposit is an advance payment credited toward the purchase price, not a refundable security deposit.
cases.glossary: automatic renewal = 자동 갱신; contract advance-payment deposit = 계약금; security deposit = 보증금
semanticChecks: Preserve the explicit denials: approval, signing this week, automatic renewal, and paying the deposit.
Resolve the otherwise ambiguous word deposit from purchase context to 계약금, not 보증금.
Do not soften factual denials into uncertainty or manufacture future commitments.

cases.text: Do not send the revised proposal today. Please send it tomorrow after 3 p.m. and before 5 p.m., Korea time.
cases.context: The previous proposal must remain unchanged until tomorrow's review.
semanticChecks: Today is prohibited; tomorrow is the requested delivery day.
Preserve both strict time boundaries: after 3 p.m. and before 5 p.m., in Korea time.

cases.text: The total price is US$125,000, excluding tax. It covers 100 units delivered each week for five weeks; it is not 100 units in total.
cases.context: The parties are checking the quantity and price in a draft order.
cases.glossary: unit = 개; excluding tax = 세금 별도
semanticChecks: Preserve 100 units per week for five weeks, not 100 units total. Do not drop or invert the correction.

cases.text: The $500 contract deposit is an advance payment toward the purchase price. The separate $2,000 security deposit is refundable when the equipment is returned undamaged.
cases.context: An equipment purchase agreement includes a temporary equipment loan.
cases.glossary: contract deposit = 계약금; security deposit = 보증금
semanticChecks: Distinguish the $500 contract advance payment from the separate $2,000 security deposit.
Only the security deposit has the stated refund condition: equipment returned without damage. Do not invent refund terms for the contract deposit.

cases.text: We could consider approval only if the security review has passed and the scope remains unchanged. That does not mean the review is complete or that approval is guaranteed.
cases.context: The vendor has requested approval today. No review result has been supplied.
cases.glossary: security review = 보안 검토; scope = 범위
semanticChecks: Keep both prerequisites and the tentative possibility of considering approval.
Do not assert that the review has passed, approval is guaranteed, or the user promises approval after review.

cases.text: Our current estimate is 14 days, but testing may take three additional days. This is an estimate, not a confirmed delivery date. Could you clarify whether weekends count?
cases.context: A delivery schedule is being discussed, with no signed deadline.
cases.glossary: estimate = 예상; confirmed delivery date = 확정 납기일
semanticChecks: Preserve the 14-day estimate and the possibility of three extra testing days.
Keep the unconfirmed status and the question about whether weekends count. Do not convert an estimate into a promise.

cases.text: 아직 계약을 승인하지 않았습니다. 보안 검토가 끝나기 전에는 시작일을 확정할 수 없습니다. 이 조건은 내일까지 유효합니다.
cases.context: A supplier has asked whether work can start today.
cases.glossary: 보안 검토 = security review; 시작일 = start date
semanticChecks: Translate the actual lack of approval as a fact, not a possibility.
The start date cannot be confirmed before security review is complete. Preserve the condition remaining valid until tomorrow.
mustNotInclude: we can confirm the start date today

cases.text: 검토 시간을 조금 더 주실 수 있을까요? 가능하다면 답변 기한을 다음 주 금요일로 연장하고 싶습니다. 지금 제안에 동의한다는 뜻은 아닙니다.
cases.context: The other party has proposed a commercial agreement. The speaker is requesting more time, not accepting it.
semanticChecks: Use a polite, easy-to-say request for more review time and a tentative extension to next Friday.
Keep the explicit distinction between requesting time and agreeing to the proposal. Do not add a promise to respond or approve.

rows.text: 우리는 계약을 승인하지 않았습니다. 이번 주에 서명하기로 약속한 적도 없고, 자동 갱신에 동의하거나 계약금을 지불한 적도 없습니다.
오늘 수정 제안서를 보내지 마세요. 내일 한국 시간으로 오후 3시 이후 그리고 오후 5시 이전에 보내 주세요.
총금액은 세금 별도로 미화 125,000달러입니다. 총 100개가 아니라, 5주 동안 매주 100개씩 납품하는 조건입니다.
500달러의 계약금은 구매 대금의 선급금입니다. 별도의 2,000달러 보증금은 장비를 파손 없이 반환할 때 환불됩니다.
보안 검토를 통과하고 범위에 변동이 없는 경우에만 승인을 고려할 수 있습니다. 그렇다고 검토가 완료되었다거나 승인이 보장된다는 뜻은 아닙니다.
현재 예상 기간은 14일이지만, 테스트에 3일이 더 소요될 수 있습니다. 이는 예상일뿐, 확정 납기일은 아닙니다. 주말이 포함되는지 명확히 말씀해 주시겠어요?
We haven't approved the contract yet. We cannot confirm the start date before the security review is finished. This condition remains valid until tomorrow.
Could you give me a little more time to review this? If possible, I'd like to extend the response deadline to next Friday. This does not mean I am agreeing to the proposal right now.
